name: Don't Give Up On Me!
source:
A confession goes wrong in multiple ways and days, but you cannot give up!

Yorokobi Akihiko has a simple yet annoying problem: He's madly in love with Yoru Aoi. But it seems like the universe conspires against him! No matter what, something goes wrong when he's trying to confess his feelings! Even so, he won't give up that easily!

In the end, will Akihiko manage to confess?

[From [url=https://stefannofornari-games.itch.io/dont-give-up-on-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一次告白可能会以多种方式、在几天内出错，但你不能放弃！

夜小比明彦有一个简单但恼人的问题：他疯狂地爱着葵夜。但似乎整个宇宙都在与他作对！不管怎样，当他试图表白自己的感情时，却出了问题！即便如此，他也不会轻易放弃！

最终，明彦能否坦白呢？

[来自[url=https://stefannofornari-games.itch.io/dont-give-up-on-me]itch.io[/url]]
